text: Why will the police have a difficult time?
The Greenwood Boys are a group of pop singers.
zh: 格林伍德男孩是一支流行歌手组合。
zh_hant: 格林伍德男孩是一支流行歌手組合。

text: At present, they are visiting all parts of the country.
zh: 目前，他们正在全国各地巡演。
zh_hant: 目前，他們正在全國各地巡演。

text: They will be arriving here tomorrow.
They will be coming by train
and most of the young people in the town will be meeting them at the station.
zh: 而且镇上大部分年轻人都会去车站迎接他们。
zh_hant: 而且鎮上大部分年輕人都會去車站迎接他們。

text: Tomorrow evening they will be singing at the Workers' Club.
zh: 明天晚上他们将在工人俱乐部演唱。
zh_hant: 明天晚上他們將在工人俱樂部演唱。

text: The Greenwood Boys will be staying for five days.
zh: 格林伍德男孩将在这里停留五天。
zh_hant: 格林伍德男孩將在這裡停留五天。

text: During this time, they will give five performances.
zh: 在此期间，他们将举行五场演出。
zh_hant: 在此期間，他們將舉行五場演出。

text: As usual, the police will have a difficult time.
zh: 和往常一样，警察将会很难办。
zh_hant: 和往常一樣，警察將會很難辦。

text: They will be trying to keep order.
It is always the same on these occasions.
